steps: Activate the idle value surface with a pointer click.
Observe the active element become .cm-content.cm-lineWrapping.
Type alpha + beta and observe a live two-line value plus the blue value-divider focus treatment.
Press Escape and observe the highlighted dummy presentation return without moving the section.
traces.result: The value persisted after reload; the value seam receives document changes while persistence remains application-owned.

steps: Hover the checked switch.
Click once and observe data-state change from checked to unchecked.
Reload and observe the unchecked value persist.
Click once more and observe checked paint plus the 16 px thumb translation.
traces.result: Exactly one visible state transition occurred per click.

steps: Open the empty pill and observe a portaled list containing Alpha, Beta, and Gamma.
Type ga and observe only Gamma plus the one-result live status.
Press ArrowDown and Enter and observe the pill value become Gamma.
Reset the temporary fixture value after the trace; host validation/persistence is outside the package seam.
traces.result: Open, filtering, keyboard navigation, selection, and close all stayed inside the control boundary and did not move the section.

steps: Open the Red trigger and observe Red, Green, and Blue swatches in a separate listbox.
Select Green.
Observe the popover close and the trigger update to the Green label and #22c55e paint.
traces.result: The configured-choice path committed one color and preserved the section geometry.

steps: Activate the idle rename_me label.
Replace it with enabled, which already exists under the same parent.
Observe red editor text, the focused underline, and the exact duplicate-name error bubble.
Restore rename_me and press Escape.
traces.result: The duplicate proposal was blocked and the committed name remained rename_me.

steps: Inspect the live idle pixels in dark and light.
Trace resolveParamUIDisabled in frozen ParamUI.tsx through isSelectingParams, frozen state, edit capability, and deployment code-param state.
Trace isDisabled into TextInputCodeMirror, SwitchInput, ConfiguredDropdownInput, and ConfiguredColorPickerInput.
Verify the disabled branch removes text activation/cursor affordances and suppresses the param-select focus divider while native controls receive disabled.
traces.result: Disabledness is an interaction contract with no blanket opacity redesign; idle captures are the pixel reference for both appearances.
